title: No loose nuke: NEST and FBI WMD staff stayed in New Jersey with their families

tellings.quote: I can tell you it wasn't loose nukes. Um and why I know that for sure is because I know people that work on the Nest team.

plain: Whatever was happening over New Jersey in 2024, it was not a lost nuclear weapon, according to Jake Barber, a former military helicopter pilot who says he flew a UFO retrieval. He says he knows this for certain because he knows people on NEST, a federal team that searches for loose nuclear material, and staff in the FBI's weapons of mass destruction section, and they stayed home in New Jersey with their families instead of fleeing. To him that rules out a nuclear threat as the explanation.
